summary: Listed as a tower in Polk County, NC, on the tnlandforms.us list with coordinates and code FB2742; no other source read describes it.

evidence.supports: tnlandforms entry for Tryon Peak, Polk County, with coordinates and code

notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms list names this tower. Checked: NHLR and firetower.org North Carolina indexes (no match), two web searches, SummitPost Tryon Peak page (no tower or fire mention), and Wikipedia pages titled Tryon Peak and Tryon Peak (North Carolina), which do not exist in the cache. The TopoQuest WTYN-AM tower near Tryon and a Pea Ridge Lookout Tower in Polk County (both seen in search results, not read) are different records and are not used. The story is under the 120-word floor because the evidence is one list entry; the editor may hold it or add a source.
